candidates.statement: Checkout p95 latency is 437.5ms while other gateway routes are ~4.75ms. Traces show the order path dominated by POST payment (~23ms) and postgres.save_order (~15.6ms) spans, with all responses 200. Bounded to elevated downstream latency on the order/payment/db path, not errors.
candidates.uncertainty: No per-dependency latency baselines or logs; cannot isolate which downstream hop dominates.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout shows elevated p95 latency (437.5ms vs ~4.75ms on other routes) with all 200s and zero 502s. Traces localize time to the order->payment and order->postgres hops. No errors, pool exhaustion, or memory pressure observed. Bounded downstream-latency candidate; logs excluded and no baselines limit precision.
